CandleFeed.title: CandleFeed

ChartMarker.title: ChartMarker

CheckOut.description: One input or output check result shown on a call card.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

CostsOut.description: Estimated spend per feature for one month, against the cap.
CostsOut.title: CostsOut

CycleGroup.description: One action+reason group inside a cycle's decisions.
CycleGroup.title: CycleGroup

CycleSlot.title: CycleSlot

(``?at=<decision id>``): every value is computed from candles that were
closed at that moment.

InsightFinding.description:
A card at the top of the Insights screen — a mechanically derived
observation from finding-level slices only.
InsightFinding.title: InsightFinding

One row of the evidence table: a slice of decisions by the chosen
dimension with its outcome metrics, all computed in the backend.
InsightSliceOut.title: InsightSliceOut

LatestDecisionOut.title: LatestDecisionOut

Everything stored for one call: the exact request and response, the
checks, retries, cost and the decision it produced.
LlmCallDetail.title: LlmCallDetail

One call-history row; ``kind == "skipped"`` is a decision row where
the Rules pre-filter passed nothing to the model.
LlmCallListItem.title: LlmCallListItem

LoggingSettings.description: The log store's knobs — every value the spec makes configurable.
LoggingSettings.title: LoggingSettings

MarketSettings-Input.description:
Market-data and eligibility thresholds — all tunable, never literals
in logic. The shared ADX threshold is used by the reads, the regime,
Rules condition C6 and Insights.
MarketSettings-Input.title: MarketSettings

MarketSettings-Output.description:
Market-data and eligibility thresholds — all tunable, never literals
in logic. The shared ADX threshold is used by the reads, the regime,
Rules condition C6 and Insights.
MarketSettings-Output.title: MarketSettings

NeedsItem.description: One thing only the user can resolve, with its single action.
NeedsItem.title: NeedsItem

OutcomeStatsRow.title: OutcomeStatsRow

PositionCardOut.title: PositionCardOut

totals; ``today`` and ``paper_account`` only for account=live.
PositionsOut.title: PositionsOut

ReadinessRowOut.description:
One live-readiness criterion: what it checks, where we stand and
what is needed, all formatted in code.
ReadinessRowOut.title: ReadinessRowOut

The live-readiness thresholds editable in Settings; the other
criteria (average R, profit factor, beats BTC, no kill, no errors) use
the spec defaults and live in app.agent.readiness.

ReadinessSettings-Output.description:
The live-readiness thresholds editable in Settings; the other
criteria (average R, profit factor, beats BTC, no kill, no errors) use
the spec defaults and live in app.agent.readiness.
ReadinessSettings-Output.title: ReadinessSettings

RiskSettings-Input.description: Every risk-gate threshold lives here, never as a literal in logic.
RiskSettings-Input.title: RiskSettings

RiskSettings-Output.description: Every risk-gate threshold lives here, never as a literal in logic.
RiskSettings-Output.title: RiskSettings

RulesSettings-Input.description:
Rules-decider thresholds — tunable without code changes; every Rules
decision stores the settings version it used.
RulesSettings-Input.title: RulesSettings

RulesSettings-Output.description:
Rules-decider thresholds — tunable without code changes; every Rules
decision stores the settings version it used.
RulesSettings-Output.title: RulesSettings

SessionOut.description:
The X-Local-Token for the served UI.

No CORS headers are sent, so other sites can call this but cannot read
the response.

Settings-Input.description:
The one validated JSON document stored in the settings table.

Unknown keys are dropped on load; new fields added later take their default.

The one validated JSON document stored in the settings table.

Unknown keys are dropped on load; new fields added later take their default.

One leaf that differs between two documents, tagged tighter /
looser / neutral by the directions map.

SettingsHistoryRowOut.title: SettingsHistoryRowOut

SettingsMetaItem.description: One leaf's description for the sectioned Settings screen.
SettingsMetaItem.title: SettingsMetaItem

SettingsPreviewOut.description:
POST /api/settings/preview: nothing is saved. ``equivalents`` maps a
dotted key to its euro amount ("€83.30"); ``errors`` maps a dotted key
to its range or cross-field message.
SettingsPreviewOut.title: SettingsPreviewOut

SettingsPreviewSummary.description:
The "What these limits mean today" sentences, as data. Money is a
decimal string; the frontend only formats it.
SettingsPreviewSummary.title: SettingsPreviewSummary

PUT /api/settings body: the whole draft, a required reason and the
"it is me" flag for saves that loosen something.

One shadow strategy for the Live / Shadow switch — running or
stopped, by name.
ShadowRefOut.title: ShadowRefOut

rest of the notification settings save through PUT /api/settings.

StopHistoryItem.description:
One stop level on a position card: the initial stop at entry, then
each breakeven/trailing move the watcher made.

TimeoutSettings.description:
One configured timeout per external call — never a literal at the
call site.

TodayItemOut.description: One fill since 00:00 Amsterdam (live account only).
TodayItemOut.title: TodayItemOut

Display thresholds for the GUI — the amber stop distance lives here
so the highlight rule is configurable, never a literal in logic.

Display thresholds for the GUI — the amber stop distance lives here
so the highlight rule is configurable, never a literal in logic.
UiSettings-Output.title: UiSettings

then open a fresh paper account. The agent is paused afterwards.

monthly cap. A target prompt with a newer brief version gets the stored
brief upgraded first — from candles closed by the call's own time.
